note: Recorded runs for the web app. Real papers are post-hoc reruns; planted and GapBench cases are development measurements. The only clean evidence is the sealed blind record (docs/CONTEXT_v11.md 5.1). Totals include every miss.

real.title: Topology attack on GCNs
real.documented_cause: The attack budget counts each edge twice, so the code's 5% perturbs twice the paper's edges.

c5.reading: An unsupported dropout=0.3; the scale probe ruled out every factor.

gauge.label: Fits but unsupported
gauge.figure: Table 3 (test accuracy, dataset=Cora, attack=CE-PGD, model=natural GCN)

c7.reading: The code's budget is 0.5x the paper's: labelled a paper-code inconsistency.

gauge.label: Paper-artifact inconsistency
gauge.figure: Table 3 (test accuracy, dataset=Cora, attack=CE-PGD, model=natural GCN)

real.title: Structural Deep Clustering Network (SDCN)
real.documented_cause: The paper reports each metric's best epoch, chosen with the test labels; the code's final epoch is lower.

c5.reading: Unexplained: the old harness recorded only the final epoch.

c7.reading: Explained by the reporting rule: each metric's best epoch, picked with the test labels.

real.title: FastGCN
real.documented_cause: A learning rate of 0.001 for the transductive Cora result.

real.title: Variational Fair Clustering
real.documented_cause: The paper's fairness weight λ=10 is a typo; the authors ran λ=100.

c5.reading: λ=100 fits all 8 claims; unsupported, since the paper prints 10.

c7.reading: λ=100 fits all 8 claims; unsupported, since the paper prints 10.

real.title: RippleNet
real.documented_cause: Book-Crossing needs lr 1e-3 and L2 weight 1e-5, not the defaults.

c5.reading: lr=0.002 closes half the gap; the documented lr=0.001 tied and lost.

c7.reading: lr=0.001, the documented value; the L2 weight is still missing.

c9.reading: Unexplained: the documented lr 1e-3 and L2 1e-5 block fit closest, one run short of its confirmation, while 30 runs sat held for a patch round that needed none.

real.title: Dropout as a Bayesian approximation (MC Dropout)
real.documented_cause: The paper ran 10x the base epochs and one hidden layer; the current code runs 500x and two.

c7.reading: epochx=10 and hidden=1, the documented pair: it fits Energy, breaks held-out Yacht.

c8.reading: epochx=10 and hidden=1 again: Energy fits, held-out Yacht breaks.

real.title: BOND: outlier detection benchmark (DOMINANT)
real.documented_cause: A library update made the balance weight stop taking effect: 0.5 runs instead of the auto-balanced 0.84.

c5.reading: Unexplained; the library probe never ran on the old harness.

c7.reading: The balance weight, patched 0.5 to 0.95; the key accepts 0.75-0.9. An 80-run search missed it.

c8.reading: Unexplained: the balance weight at 0.95 fit the target on one run and was never repeated, with 13 of 60 runs left.

real.title: Variational Graph Auto-Encoders (VGAE)
real.documented_cause: The code splits 30% / 20% of edges for test and validation; the paper used 10% / 5%.

c5.reading: The split pair fits, but a cut made on one run demoted it.

c7.reading: The split constants are written `30.`, a form the value ladder couldn't read.

c9.reading: A paper-code inconsistency: the split constants at the paper's 10% and 5% close the gap (-5.4% to +0.3%).

real.title: pygcn, the PyTorch GCN
real.documented_cause: Splits, normalization, input dropout and first-layer-only weight decay differ from the paper's setup.

c7.reading: Lists the validation split (500 vs 300) and the missing early stopping.

c9.reading: weight_decay=1e-5, unsupported; this time the paper-code contrast named no difference.

real.title: PatchTST
real.documented_cause: The test loader drops its last incomplete batch (drop_last=True).

c7.reading: drop_last tested on the live line: no effect here. The target is the 512-step PatchTST/64; the harness runs /42.

c8.reading: Unexplained, as on c7: the 512-step variant the paper reports isn't in the harness.

real.title: Graph Attention Networks (GAT)
real.documented_cause: PubMed used its own settings: lr 0.01, L2 0.001, 8 output heads, early stopping on loss only.

c5.reading: Inconclusive: the gap is under the minimum detectable effect.

c7.reading: Reproduced: this run's naive spread covers the -2.2% gap.

real.title: SparseTSF
real.documented_cause: The test loader drops its last incomplete batch.

real.title: Anomaly Transformer
real.documented_cause: A point-adjustment step the paper states is applied in evaluation.

real.title: Neural Collaborative Filtering (NCF)
real.documented_cause: The best epoch is picked on the test set.

real.title: G-Mixup
real.documented_cause: The gain over plain GNNs is within the run-to-run noise.

real.title: GAT vs GCN in PyTorch Geometric
real.documented_cause: The ranking of GAT and GCN depends on the data split.
